da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: major-revision (as a conjecture, accept-with-caveats). referee_argument: The honest core — define 𝔙∈ℂ, set binding=Re, Q_β=Im, observe the trivial reconstruction is provable, axiomatise the physical match as a class — is methodologically clean and correctly typed conjectural. Two substantive objections: (1) lean.ref/narrative divergence — the ref names the unproved ComplexVolumeMatch class while the prose's 'proved sorry-free' attaches to the trivial Re/Im identity, so 'proved' oversells what Lean delivers (major, da-lean-narrative-divergence); (2) the 'single normalisation' must match both Re and Im simultaneously yet is an unpinned free scale (hidden-dof, warn), and Im(q_0)=0 means the Q_β channel only exists at an unspecified off-q_0 evaluation (definitional-ambiguity). The c_2≈−8 / c_2=−1 'exactly what Re/Im predict' inference is weaker than stated. Fix: repoint lean.ref or re-word 'proved' to scope it to the definitional identity; pin the normalisation and the Q_β evaluation point.

The precise evaluation point that yields a nonzero Im (the actual measured Q_β) is not pinned — the same Re/Im-at-which-q ambiguity flagged for the intro. The STRICT caveat names it but the operational evaluation map remains underspecified.
